Can you explain the main options in simple terms?
Here’s a simple breakdown of your main options with us:
Paying: Use MasterCard, Amex, Visa, or PayPal; refunds go back to the original payment method.
Ordering online: Add items to cart, choose delivery, then checkout and pay.
Delivery: Standard/Express (signature needed); large/heavy items ship at a flat rate.
If you’re not home: Driver leaves a card and your order goes to a collection center; re-delivery fees may apply.
Email preferences: Adjust what emails you receive via “Manage My Preferences” in any CAMILLA email footer.
Changing/cancelling after purchase: Wait for delivery, then follow our returns steps.
Order confirmation: You’ll see a confirmation page, get a confirmation email, and can view orders in your account.
Help placing an order: Visit a boutique or use Live Chat, Phone, or Email.
Security: We use various measures to protect your data; card details are processed securely via Braintree and tokenized.
